title: Prompt Shield
summary: A static repository intake filter that labels instruction-like text and redacts secret-shaped values before review.
intended_users: Hackathon assessors reviewing untrusted public repository evidence.

design_decisions.problem_or_constraint: The project explains bounded detection and quarantine trade-offs without claiming complete prompt-injection prevention.
design_decisions.alternatives_considered: The committed alternatives table compares benefits, rejected costs, and the condition that triggers reconsideration.
design_decisions.chosen_approach_and_rationale: Normalization, signal detection, secret redaction, policy, and audit output remain separately testable.
design_decisions.accepted_trade_off: Heuristic signals cannot establish that all semantically equivalent indirect instructions are detected.
design_decisions.validation_approach: Quarantine text that instructs an evaluator to award a maximum score. Annotate rather than blindly quarantine a defensive document quoting an attack. Redact a secret-shaped assignment while preserving its evidence location.
design_decisions.reconsideration_conditions: Heuristic signals cannot establish that all semantically equivalent indirect instructions are detected. The committed adversarial corpus intentionally provides incomplete non-English coverage.

testing_strategy: Committed cross-boundary, negative, and boundary tests: test/adversarial-corpus.test.js, test/redaction.test.js. Their presence does not establish that they pass in Finch static review.
security_threat: Repository content attempts to control the assessment process or override evaluation instructions. Control: The pipeline labels instruction-like evidence and returns structured reasons without executing or forwarding it as authority. A committed fake or real credential assignment is copied into downstream evidence or output. Control: Credential-shaped values are replaced with typed redaction markers while paths and signal kinds remain auditable.
production_limitation: Heuristic signals cannot establish that all semantically equivalent indirect instructions are detected. The committed adversarial corpus intentionally provides incomplete non-English coverage.
technical_debt: Complete deployment-specific runtime, performance, accessibility, and security evaluation before production use.
track_alignment_explanation: The product primarily detects, contains, and supports investigation of prompt influence and secret-exfiltration threats.

ai_disclosure.purposes: Codex was used to author this deliberately synthetic calibration fixture and its structured submission answers.
ai_disclosure.substantially_generated_areas: All fixture source, documentation, tests, and submission narratives are synthetic and AI-assisted.
ai_disclosure.review_validation: The calibration operator reviews files for intended evidence strength, consistency, and absence of real secrets before pinning the commit.
ai_disclosure.rejected_or_changed_suggestion: Generic claims of runtime correctness were rejected because Finch performs static evidence review only.

ai_disclosure_narrative: This entire project is synthetic AI-assisted test data. It represents no participant, deployed product, or real credential.
